definition: 疾病的临床表现，包括主观症状和客观体征
label: Symptom_Sign

umls_mapping.definition: Clinical manifestations that can be either objective when observed by a physician, or subjective when perceived by the patient.

definition: 患者主观描述的症状
label: Subjective_Symptom

definition: 通过检查或测量获得的体征
label: Objective_Sign

umls_mapping.definition: The end-result or objective, which may be specified or required in advance.

definition: 胸部相关的主观症状
label: Chest_Symptom

definition: 疼痛放射至其他部位的症状
label: Radiating_Pain

definition: 伴随主要症状的其他主观症状
label: Associated_Symptom

umls_mapping.definition: Joined in some kind of relationship.

definition: 生命体征测量异常
label: Vital_Sign_Abnormality

definition: 心脏相关体征
label: Cardiac_Sign

definition: 其他部位的体征
label: Other_Sign

umls_mapping.definition: Objective evidence of disease perceptible to the examining healthcare provider.

definition: 胸部区域的疼痛感觉
label: Chest_Pain

definition: 胸部憋闷、呼吸不畅的感觉
label: Chest_Tightness

umls_mapping.definition: The upper part of the trunk between the NECK and the ABDOMEN. It contains the chief organs of the circulatory and respiratory systems. (From Stedman, 25th ed)

definition: 胸部模糊的不适感
label: Chest_Discomfort

definition: 左侧上肢的疼痛
label: Left_Arm_Pain

definition: 颈部的疼痛
label: Neck_Pain

definition: 下颌部的疼痛
label: Jaw_Pain

definition: 背部的疼痛
label: Back_Pain

definition: 呼吸费力或呼吸不足的主观感觉
label: Dyspnea

umls_mapping.definition: Breathlessness at rest or without exertion.

definition: 胃部不适，有呕吐冲动的感觉
label: Nausea

umls_mapping.definition: Actions performed to control the distaste for food and desire to vomit

definition: 胃内容物反向经口排出
label: Vomiting

definition: 心跳异常的主观感觉
label: Palpitation

definition: 全身疲乏无力感
label: Fatigue

umls_mapping.definition: A response indicating that an individual has not experienced any fatigue.

definition: 异常的出汗现象
label: Diaphoresis

umls_mapping.definition: Lack of sweating or the ability to sweat when provoked by the appropriate stimulus.

definition: 血压测量值异常
label: Blood_Pressure_Abnormality

umls_mapping.definition: Techniques used for measuring BLOOD PRESSURE.

definition: 心率测量值异常
label: Heart_Rate_Abnormality

definition: 心跳节律的异常
label: Arrhythmia

umls_mapping.definition: An electrocardiographic finding of an atypical cardiac rhythm resulting from a pathologic process in the cardiac atria.

definition: 听诊发现的异常心脏杂音
label: Heart_Murmur

umls_mapping.definition: Heart murmurs which are systolic in timing. They occur between the first and the second HEART SOUNDS, between the closure of MITRAL VALVE and TRICUSPID VALVE and the closure of semilunar aortic and pulmonary valves. Systolic murmurs include ejection murmurs and regurgitant murmurs.

definition: 四肢或其他部位的水肿
label: Peripheral_Edema

definition: 如重物压迫般的胸部疼痛
label: Crushing_Chest_Pain

definition: 如火烧般的胸部疼痛
label: Burning_Chest_Pain

umls_mapping.definition: The sensation of chest pain described as an intense discomfort, similar to that experience as a result of a thermal burn, distinct from sharp, stabbing or aching, often related to nerves; sometimes used to describe gastric or esophageal pain.

definition: 如针刺般的胸部疼痛
label: Sharp_Chest_Pain

definition: 钝性胀痛感的胸部疼痛
label: Dull_Chest_Pain

umls_mapping.definition: The sensation of chest pain described as a mild or blunted discomfort.

definition: 活动时出现的呼吸困难
label: Exertional_Dyspnea

definition: 静息状态下的呼吸困难
label: Rest_Dyspnea

umls_mapping.definition: Breathlessness at rest or without exertion.

definition: 平卧时加重，坐起后缓解的呼吸困难
label: Orthopnea

umls_mapping.definition: Breathlessness in the recumbent position.

definition: 血压持续升高
label: Hypertension

umls_mapping.definition: Hypertension characterized diastolic blood pressure greater than 90 mmHg on two occasions.

clinical_significance: 可能提示心功能不全或休克
definition: 血压持续降低
label: Hypotension

definition: 心率过快
label: Tachycardia

umls_mapping.definition: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of an organized, regular atrial rhythm with atrial rate between 101 and 240 beats per minute. The P wave morphology must be distinct from the sinus P wave morphology. (CDISC)

definition: 心率过慢
label: Bradycardia

umls_mapping.definition: A disorder characterized by an electrocardiographic finding of abnormally slow heart rate with its origin in the sinus node. Thresholds for different age, gender, and patient populations exist. (CDISC)

definition: A condition where the left ventricle of the heart has reduced pumping efficiency, often indicated by decreased systolic shortening or other abnormalities.
label: Decreased left ventricular function

umls_mapping.definition: A subjective response indicating that something is or has decreased.

definition: Abnormal movement of a segment of the heart wall during the cardiac cycle, often indicative of ischemic myocardial damage.
label: Regional_Wall_Motion_Abnormality

definition: A condition where the left ventricle of the heart is not functioning properly, often leading to reduced cardiac output.
label: Left_Ventricle_Dysfunction

umls_mapping.definition: A condition in which the LEFT VENTRICLE of the heart was functionally impaired. This condition usually leads to HEART FAILURE; MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION; and other cardiovascular complications. Diagnosis is made by measuring the diminished ejection fraction and a depressed level of motility of the left ventricular wall.

definition: Bleeding that occurs without any apparent cause or trauma
label: Spontaneous_Bleeding

definition: A transient loss of consciousness due to temporary reduction in blood flow to the brain.
label: Syncope

umls_mapping.definition: An episode of lightheadedness and dizziness which may precede an episode of syncope.

definition: An abnormal response of the microcirculatory system, often observed in patients with angina but without obstructive epicardial coronary arteries.
label: Abnormal_Microcirculatory_Response

umls_mapping.definition: Deviating in any way from the state, position, structure, condition, behavior, or rule which is considered a norm.

definition: Transient changes in the ST segment of an ECG, which can indicate myocardial ischemia or other cardiac conditions.
label: ST-segment_elevations_or_depressions

umls_mapping.definition: The condition of being elevated.

definition: Coronary Calcium Score (CCS) related symptom characteristics used for assessing likelihood of obstructive CAD
label: CCS_Symptom_Characteristic

name_cn: 心绞痛频率或身体限制
definition: The frequency of angina episodes or the physical limitations experienced by patients with angina.
label: Anginal Frequency or Physical Limitations

definition: A condition characterized by a significantly lower than normal number of red blood cells or hemoglobin, leading to reduced oxygen transport.
label: Severe_Anemia

umls_mapping.definition: Intensely bad or unpleasant in degree, quality or extent.

definition: A condition characterized by reduced ability of blood vessels to dilate, often leading to impaired blood flow.
label: Impaired_Vasodilation

umls_mapping.definition: Loss or abnormality of psychological, physiological, or anatomic structure or function.

name_cn: 血流介导的血管舒张功能缺失
definition: The absence or reduction of the normal increase in blood vessel diameter in response to increased blood flow, often indicating endothelial dysfunction.
label: Lack_of_flow-mediated_vasodilation

name_cn: 宏观和微观循环血管收缩
definition: A condition characterized by the constriction of both macro- and microcirculatory blood vessels, potentially leading to reduced blood flow and ischemia.
label: Macro- and Microcirculatory Vasoconstriction

definition: Characteristics of chest pain used to classify angina types (typical, atypical, or non-cardiac/non-anginal)
label: Chest_Pain_Characteristics

umls_mapping.definition: An aspect of personal behavior or lifestyle, environmental exposure, inborn or inherited characteristic, which, based on epidemiological evidence, is known to be associated with a health-related condition considered important to prevent.

definition: A scoring system that categorizes chest pain based on the number of characteristics present, with three characteristics as 'typical' angina (3 points), two of three characteristics as 'atypical' angina (2 points), and no or one characteristic as 'non-cardiac/non-anginal' (0–1 point).
label: Angina_Symptom_Score

name_cn: 非心脏性或非心绞痛性胸痛特征
definition: Defined as having no or one characteristic of chest pain, as opposed to 'typical' or 'atypical' angina.
label: Non-cardiac_or_non-anginal_chest_pain_characteristic

name_cn: 非心脏性/非心绞痛性胸痛
definition: Chest pain with no or only one characteristic of angina, indicating a non-cardiac or non-anginal origin.
label: Non-cardiac_Non-anginal

definition: Patient-reported symptoms suggestive of angina pectoris
label: Anginal_complaints

definition: A scoring system to classify angina based on the number of chest pain characteristics present.
label: Angina symptom score

definition: A scoring system to classify chest pain characteristics as 'typical' angina (3 points), 'atypical' angina (2 points), or 'non-cardiac/non-anginal' (0-1 point).
label: Angina_Symptom_Score

definition: A condition characterized by spasms in the epicardial coronary arteries, often leading to reduced blood flow and myocardial ischemia.
label: Epicardial_Spasm

definition: Symptoms caused by insufficient blood supply to the heart muscle due to coronary artery disease or other conditions.
label: Symptoms_of_Myocardial_Ischemia

umls_mapping.definition: An electrocardiographic finding of ST and T wave changes consistent with impaired myocardial perfusion.

definition: Acute coronary syndrome patients presenting with spontaneous bleeding, which has been associated with subsequent cancer diagnosis.
label: Spontaneous_bleeding_in_ACS

umls_mapping.definition: Autosomal recessive syndrome characterized by hypogenesis or agenesis of CORPUS CALLOSUM. Clinical features include MENTAL RETARDATION; CRANIOFACIAL ABNORMALITIES; digital malformations, and growth retardation.

definition: Symptoms associated with myocardial ischemia, which may include chest pain, shortness of breath, and fatigue.
label: Myocardial_Ischemia_Symptoms

umls_mapping.definition: An electrocardiographic finding of ST and T wave changes consistent with impaired myocardial perfusion.

definition: Symptoms such as dyspnoea and fatigue that are not typical of angina.
label: Non_Anginal_Symptoms

definition: An abnormal narrowing of blood vessels due to constriction of the muscular walls of the vessels.
label: Abnormal_Vasoconstriction

umls_mapping.definition: Deviating in any way from the state, position, structure, condition, behavior, or rule which is considered a norm.

definition: Complications characterized by bleeding, often associated with cardiovascular conditions.
label: Haemorrhagic_Events

umls_mapping.definition: A morphologic finding indicating a change in a tissue due to vascular injury or leakage.

definition: An ECG finding indicating myocardial ischemia during low levels of physical exertion, often associated with high risk of cardiac mortality.
label: ST-segment depression at low workload

umls_mapping.definition: An electrocardiographic finding of ST segment depression below the baseline, often described as up sloping, down sloping or horizontal.

definition: An individual's reduced ability to perform physical activities, often associated with cardiovascular or respiratory conditions.
label: Low_Exercise_Capacity

umls_mapping.definition: A minimum level or position or degree; less than normal in degree, intensity or amount.

definition: An atypical change in blood pressure during physical exertion or other activities, often indicating cardiovascular risk.
label: Abnormal blood pressure response

definition: The intensity or seriousness of symptoms experienced by the patient.
label: Symptom_Severity

umls_mapping.definition: Used of the degree of something undesirable e.g. pain or weather; also, strictness.

definition: A reflex action to clear the throat and airways of irritants or mucus.
label: Cough

definition: A sharp, pricking pain sensation.
label: Stinging_Pain

definition: A reduced probability of having CCS (Chronic Cardiac Syndrome) based on clinical context.
label: Less_Likelihood_of_CCS

definition: Abnormalities in the repolarization phase of the cardiac cycle, often detected as ST-segment depressions or T wave abnormalities.
label: Repolarization_Abnormality

definition: Negative results or complications associated with a medical condition or treatment
label: Adverse_Outcomes

name_cn: 区域性收缩期室壁增厚异常
definition: Abnormalities in the thickening of the ventricular wall during systole, often indicative of myocardial ischemia.
label: Regional_Systolic_Wall-Thickening_Abnormality

umls_mapping.definition: Of or belonging to a broader area or region of the body.

definition: An increase in the oxygen requirement of the heart muscle, often due to increased workload or reduced supply.
label: Myocardial_Oxygen_Demand_Increase

definition: A condition where there is an abnormal accumulation of fluid in the lungs, often visualized through B-lines on lung ultrasound.
label: Lung_Congestion

definition: An abnormal accumulation of fluid in the lungs, often due to heart failure or other cardiac conditions.
label: Pulmonary_Congestion

definition: Patient-reported severe symptoms
label: Severe_Symptom

umls_mapping.definition: Intensely bad or unpleasant in degree, quality or extent.

definition: Significant adverse events following a medical procedure, such as bleeding requiring blood transfusions.
label: Major_Complications

definition: A condition where bleeding is severe enough to necessitate blood transfusions.
label: Bleeding Requiring Blood Transfusions

umls_mapping.definition: Bleeding originating from the anal area.

definition: A decrease in the occurrence of significant bleeding events, often associated with specific medical procedures or treatments.
label: Reduced_Major_Bleeding

umls_mapping.definition: Made less in size or amount or degree.

definition: The process of identifying ischemia, a condition characterized by inadequate blood supply to an organ or part of the body.
label: Ischemia_Identification

umls_mapping.definition: A hypoperfusion of the BLOOD through an organ or tissue caused by a PATHOLOGIC CONSTRICTION or obstruction of its BLOOD VESSELS, or an absence of BLOOD CIRCULATION.

definition: Symptoms that do not respond to medical therapy.
label: Medical_Therapy_Unresponsive_Symptoms

definition: An electrocardiographic finding indicating a depression in the ST segment, which may suggest myocardial ischemia or other cardiac conditions.
label: ST-segment depression

umls_mapping.definition: An electrocardiographic finding of ST segment depression below the baseline, often described as up sloping, down sloping or horizontal.

definition: A condition where the diastolic relaxation velocities of the heart are impaired, often associated with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) and coronary microvascular dysfunction (CMD).
label: worse diastolic relaxation velocities

umls_mapping.definition: Post-systolic relaxation of the HEART, especially the HEART VENTRICLES.

definition: Reduced ability to perform physical activities at the expected level or duration due to symptoms like fatigue or dyspnea
label: Exercise_Intolerance

umls_mapping.definition: Physical activity which is usually regular and done with the intention of improving or maintaining PHYSICAL FITNESS or HEALTH. Contrast with PHYSICAL EXERTION which is concerned largely with the physiologic and metabolic response to energy expenditure.

name_cn: 应激状态下可见性问题
definition: 在应激状态下出现的可见性问题，常用于描述心脏超声检查中某些节段在应激状态下不可见的情况
label: Visibility_Issues_During_Stress

umls_mapping.definition: The negative mental, emotional, and physical reactions that occur when environmental stressors are perceived as exceeding the individual's adaptive capacities.

definition: A severe, potentially life-threatening allergic reaction that can occur rapidly after exposure to an allergen.
label: Anaphylactic_Reaction

umls_mapping.definition: Progression of anaphylaxis into systemic shock, which is characterized by significant reduction in tissue perfusion which leads to hypoxia and hypotension, and can lead to death if untreated.
